update_confirm:
Update to version {version}.
The QGIS launcher will exit once and restart automatically after the update. Continue?
update_started: Update started. The launcher will restart automatically when it finishes.
label_exclude_dirs: Folders excluded from sync (one per line)
label_project_root: File location (project_root) *blank = same folder as qgis_settings.json
note_port_restart: Changes take effect after the server restarts.
status_launched: QGIS launched. The server will stop automatically.
confirm_reset: Existing QGIS profiles will be deleted and the distributed profiles will be copied again. Continue?
status_saved_port: Port saved. It takes effect from the next launch
err_port_range: Specify a port in the range 1024-65535
status_saved_root: File location saved. It takes effect from the next launch
confirm_stop:
Stop the Axum server?
This page will become unusable until the launcher is restarted.
status_stop_sent: Sent stop request to the server
status_server_unreachable: Cannot connect to the server. The launcher may have exited. ({msg})
status_server_stopped_close: The server has stopped. Restart the launcher or close this tab.
tip_tab_launch: Choose a profile, role, project and QGIS version, then launch
tip_tab_paths: Folders searched for QGIS project files
tip_tab_raw: Advanced settings: local_sync, drive mappings, path aliases and raw JSON
tip_tab_maint: Maintenance: file location, listen port, server stop and updates
tip_role: User role passed to QGIS (Viewer / Editor / Administrator)
tip_project: Project (.qgs/.qgz) to open at launch. The list is built from the search paths
tip_project_version: QGIS version that last saved the selected project (read-only)
tip_qgis_exe: QGIS executable to run. Detected installations are listed automatically
tip_btn_reset: Delete existing QGIS profiles and re-copy the distributed profiles
tip_btn_save_launch: Save the selected profile, role, project and QGIS version to qgis_settings.json
tip_btn_launch: Launch QGIS with the current settings. This server stops automatically after launch
tip_project_sources: Folders to search for .qgs/.qgz projects, one per line
tip_btn_save_paths: Save the search paths and refresh the project list
tip_btn_reload_all: Reload settings, profiles, projects and QGIS versions from the server
tip_subtab_localsync: local_sync: mirror a folder to another folder at startup (robocopy /MIR)
tip_subtab_drives: Assign drive letters to local folders or remote storage (the drive_mappings section)
tip_subtab_aliases: Cloud storage aliases and detected paths
tip_subtab_raw: View and edit qgis_settings.json directly as JSON
tip_field_sync_src: sync_src: Folder whose contents are mirrored to the destination at startup. Skipped if it does not exist
tip_field_sync_dst: sync_dst: Destination folder. Kept identical to the source (mirrored)
tip_field_exclude_dirs: exclude_dirs: Folder names excluded from sync (robocopy /XD, one per line)
tip_drive_drive: drive: Drive letter to assign (e.g. Q:)
tip_drive_local_cache: local_cache: Backing folder assigned to the drive via subst. Also serves as the sync destination for robocopy_src/remote
tip_drive_mode: mode: subst: map local_cache to the drive. sync: copy remote with rclone. mount: rclone mount (needs WinFsp)
tip_drive_read_only: read_only: Only for mount mode: passes --read-only to rclone mount (read-only remote drive). Selectable only when mode=mount
tip_drive_remote: remote: Remote to sync/mount, e.g. myremote:bucket/path (sync/mount modes only)
tip_drive_robocopy_src: robocopy_src: If set, this folder is mirrored to local_cache with robocopy before subst
tip_drive_robocopy_exclude: robocopy_exclude: Subfolder names excluded by robocopy, one per line
tip_drive_vfs_cache_mode: vfs_cache_mode: rclone VFS cache mode for mount (off / minimal / writes / full)
tip_alias_path: Actual folder the alias expands to
tip_raw_settings: Raw contents of qgis_settings.json, saved with 'Save JSON settings'
tip_btn_save_json: Validate and save the JSON to qgis_settings.json
tip_btn_reload: Discard edits and reload the current settings
tip_project_root: Base folder for distributed files. Blank = the folder containing qgis_settings.json
tip_btn_save_project_root: Save the file location to qgis_settings.json
tip_port: HTTP listen port of this launcher. Applied after the next restart
tip_btn_stop_server: Stop the Axum server. This page becomes unusable until the launcher restarts
tip_btn_check_update: Check the update server for a new version
tip_update_apply: Download and apply the update. The launcher restarts automatically
tip_update_dismiss: Hide this banner until the next update check
tip_btn_browse: Open a folder picker to fill in this path
tip_btn_help: Open the documentation site in your browser
note_aliases: Reference cloud storage roots with short names (aliases), e.g. BOX:\xxx in any path field. Below are the paths actually detected on this PC.
cloud_prep_box: Install the Box Drive app and set the target folder to offline sync (always keep on this device).
cloud_prep_onedrive: The %OneDrive% environment variable is set automatically while the OneDrive app is running.
cloud_prep_onedrive_commercial: The %OneDriveCommercial% environment variable is set automatically after sign-in.
cloud_prep_google_drive: Install Google Drive for Desktop and check the assigned drive letter (e.g. G:).
cloud_prep_sharepoint: Open the target site's document library in a browser and click Sync to sync it with OneDrive. The local folder created after sync is detected here.
note_local_sync: At startup, the contents of the source folder are mirrored to the destination folder (robocopy /MIR; only changed files are copied). Skipped if the source folder does not exist.
